Performers
Eliza Hansen (harpsichord) Documented

Commons explicitly identifies Hansen and the harpsichord. The instrument’s builder, model and pitch standard are not established from the selected file’s documentation.

[1]
Work version
Complete two-movement sonata for keyboard, performed on harpsichord Documented

Hansen’s performing edition is unidentified. The section map includes the repeat of the first movement’s Moderato and Molto allegro, followed by Presto; times are broad passage guideposts.

[1] [2] [3]
Recorded
1953-10-22/1953-10-23 Documented

The author/session field gives 22–⁠23 October 1953. The individual take’s day is unspecified.

[1]

Commons gives Hannover and spells the venue ‘Beetovensaal’; the conventional spelling is used here.

Composition rights
Public domain: Scarlatti’s eighteenth-century composition Documented

Commons applies PD-old-70-expired. The 1756 date belongs to the Venice manuscript copy. Gouin’s modern score is cited for research and is not redistributed here.

[1] [2] [4]
Recording rights
Public domain in the European Union under Commons’ PD-EU-audio designation Documented

The host’s licence field is Public domain. Its licensing section also warns of continuing US protection for this pre-1972 sound recording. The EU designation does not provide worldwide clearance.

[1]

Domenico Scarlatti, Sonata in C major, K. 513, Pastorale; Eliza Hansen, harpsichord, Hannover, 22–⁠23 October 1953. Archiv 13001 AP; Médiathèque musicale Mahler collection; Commons upload by Flopinot2012. Commons PD-EU-audio; US recording restrictions remain. Rights statement

  1. Wikimedia Commons — Hansen, Scarlatti Sonata K. 513 — Description identifies the harpsichord and performer; author field supplies session range and Hannover venue. Source reference Archiv 13001 AP; licensing, file history, duration and MP3 transcode.. Accessed 2026-10-18.
  2. IMSLP — Keyboard Sonata in C major, K. 513 — General Information: catalogue concordances, C major, keyboard, two movements: Pastorale, Moderato–Molto allegro; Presto.. Accessed 2026-10-18.
  3. Scarlatti — Sonata K. 513, Pierre Gouin edition — Les Éditions Outremontaises, 2013; all four pages inspected visually. Moderato in twelve-eight; Molto allegro from bar 17; Presto in three-eight from bar 36; repeat signs and final cadence.. Accessed 2026-10-18.
  4. Sonate K. 513 — manuscript witnesses — Manuscrits: Venice XII, no. 30, Ms. 9783 (1756), copied for Maria Bárbara; also Parma XIV, no. 30.. Accessed 2026-10-18.
  5. Giulio d’Amore — Scarlatti Sonata in C major, K. 513 — Accademia Nazionale di Santa Cecilia programme, Rome, 13 February 1998: southern Italian pastoral associations and fast toccata-like conclusion.. Accessed 2026-10-18.
